stdout:
Issue #13 is a standalone easy-call with a bounded, two-way annotation-binding correction. At pinned main 4cabe417c868b343fa458a6e42b1da7a4813ec52, ToOneBinder.bindOneToOne calls bindForeignKeyNameAndDefinition, whose nestedForeignKey reads only JoinColumn and JoinColumns. It never reads member PrimaryKeyJoinColumn or PrimaryKeyJoinColumns. BinderHelper already offers resolveContainerForeignKey(ForeignKey, PrimaryKeyJoinColumn[]) and the common handler applies NO_CONSTRAINT, names, definitions and options. Extend only the missing annotation lookup; retain JoinColumn precedence and existing container resolution rather than redesigning helpers.

Alberto Michele supplied the report and inline examples. Do not claim Jakarta annotation behavior was working in 6.6: the older example used the removed Hibernate annotation. HHH-15052 concerns class-level JOINED inheritance, not this member-level path. Existing ForeignKeyConstraintTest covers class-level primary-key declarations; ForeignKeyNoConstraintTest combines JoinColumn with PrimaryKeyJoinColumn and does not isolate the reported bug.

First establish RED on unchanged current main using a nonoptional shared-primary-key member association with NO_CONSTRAINT plus default-FK and explicit-name cases. After the smallest correction, separately add plural container and nested-column coverage, and retain existing JoinColumn neighbors. Prefer metadata/schema export and H2 through existing test infrastructure. Verify focused JDK 25/H2 checks and formatChecks. No public signatures, classifications or persisted formats need changes; schema output changes only to honor explicit mapping intent. No full-build or other database claim.

CONTRIBUTING.md, classification-tooling.adoc and Sandcastle coding standards were read; target CONTEXT.md and target .sandcastle/CODING_STANDARDS.md are absent. No code changes or runtime tests were performed during exploration. No duplicates in this one-issue batch. Runtime RED remains an implementation-stage requirement; plural declaration resolution must match existing helper semantics.
